fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Commandline to launch powershell with a base64 payload
fields.name: Suspicious Execution of Powershell with Base64
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\powershell.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\pwsh.exe") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " -e " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " -en " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " -enc " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " -enco" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " -ec ")) and (not (tgt.process.cmdline contains " -Encoding " or (src.process.image.path contains "C:\\Packages\\Plugins\\Microsoft.GuestConfiguration.ConfigurationforWindows\\" or src.process.image.path contains "\\gc_worker.exe")))))
